tools.name: fx_rates_latest
tools.description: Retrieve latest available exchange rates from the Frankfurter API (ECB data). Rates are delayed reference rates, not real-time market rates. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/fx/rates/latest. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fx_rates_historical
tools.description: Retrieve exchange rates for a specific date from the Frankfurter API (ECB data). Returns rates for the closest working day. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/fx/rates/historical. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fx_rates_timeseries
tools.description: Retrieve exchange rates over a date range from the Frankfurter API (ECB data). Returns rates for each working day in the range. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/fx/rates/timeseries. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fx_rates_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between currencies using delayed reference rates from the Frankfurter API (ECB data). Rates are not real-time market rates. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/fx/rates/convert. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: fx_currencies_list
tools.description: Retrieve the list of supported currencies from the Frankfurter API. All currencies are ISO 4217 codes. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/fx/currencies/list. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "fx" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fx_rates_latest, fx_rates_historical, fx_rates_timeseries, fx_currencies_list · Public sink: fx_rates_latest, fx_rates_historical, fx_rates_timeseries, fx_rates_convert, fx_currencies_list · Destructive: fx_rates_latest, fx_rates_historical, fx_rates_timeseries, fx_rates_convert, fx_currencies_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fx_rates_latest, fx_rates_historical, fx_rates_timeseries, fx_currencies_list · Public sink: fx_rates_latest, fx_rates_historical, fx_rates_timeseries, fx_rates_convert, fx_currencies_list · Destructive: fx_rates_latest, fx_rates_historical, fx_rates_timeseries, fx_rates_convert, fx_currencies_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
